jobs.title: Assistant (BS-15) - DGTO
jobs.description:
Applications are invited from candidates holding Local/Domicile Certificate of Balochistan to fill the vacancies on regular basis in the Directorate General of Trade Organizations (DGTO) working under the administrative control of Ministry of Commerce
Job Details
Education : 2nd Class Bachelors Degree from HEC recognized University.
Experience : 05 Years’ experience of dealing official matters, maintenance of office record (Preferable).
Skills : Basic IT skills (MS Office etc.) Preferable
Place of Posting : Islamabad / Karachi

jobs.title: Stenotypist (S-II/BS-14) - EDF
jobs.description:
Applications are invited from candidates holding Local/Domicile Certificate of Balochistan to fill the vacancies on regular basis in the Export Development Fund (EDF), an Autonomous Body working under the administrative control of Ministry of Commerce
Job Details
Age Limit : 18–25 years + 05 years general relaxation + 05 years specific additional relaxation for candidates from Balochistan
Education : Intermediate
Experience : 05 years post qualification experience in administrative matters, tendering, accounts, ERP systems and proficiency in MS Office etc. (Preferable)
Place of Posting : Islamabad
